newsitem.title: USA: Canyon Resources adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Canyon Resources adopts rights plan.

text.p: Canyon Resources Corp said its board had adopted a shareholder rights plan that becomes exercisable if a third party acquires 20 percent or more of the company's common stock.
The board declared a dividend distribution of one common stock purchase right on each outstanding share, to shareholders of record April 15.
The plan expires March 20, 2007, the company said in a statement released Monday.

"The objective of this rights plan is to deter abusive takeover tactics by encouraging potential acquirors to deal with the company's board of directors rather than to attempt a hostile takeover," the company said.
The company was not available for further comment.
